subject: Quick clarification about the mockup
text: Hi, I wanted to follow up on my earlier note about the mockup, because I made it sound more settled than it actually is. The practical concern is timing, not design: if we send that version tomorrow, I would need the copy blocks by this evening, and I have not received confirmation on the second column yet. Could you clarify whether you meant a single revision today or a full review before the client call? I can keep the layout if you want, but I would need the revised headline, one alternate subheading, and a yes or no on the footer spacing. If any of that is still in flux, just tell me what you can safely freeze and what should stay open. A short reply by end of the day is all I need to move ahead cleanly.
